en.headline: Phased road closures set for National Day fireworks on Thursday
en.dek: Police will shut major roads on both sides of Victoria Harbour from Thursday afternoon for the 23-minute display expected to draw about 260,000 spectators.
body: Police announced phased road closures on both sides of Victoria Harbour from Thursday afternoon to facilitate the National Day fireworks display, which begins at 8 pm and lasts about 23 minutes.

In Kowloon, closures start at 5 pm in Tsim Sha Tsui and Tsim Sha Tsui East, affecting Canton Road, Nathan Road, Salisbury Road and surrounding streets. Further waves follow at 5.30 pm, 6 pm and 7.45 pm, covering Kowloon Park Drive, the Star Ferry Bus Terminus, West Kowloon Cultural District and additional roads in Tsim Sha Tsui and Hung Hom.

On Hong Kong Island, most closures begin at 6.30 pm across Central, Wan Chai and the Eastern District. Golden Bauhinia Square closes earlier at 4 pm. The Central-Wan Chai Bypass and sections of the Island Eastern Corridor will also be affected.

A restricted zone will be imposed in the central harbour from 7 pm. Land boundary control points will not extend their operating hours. Temporary cross-boundary bus stops will be set up outside West Kowloon Station for services to Huanggang and Shenzhen Bay.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花匯演周四晚舉行 維港兩岸分階段封路
zh.dek: 煙花約晚上8時開始、歷時23分鐘，預計吸引約26萬人觀賞，警方下午5時起在九龍及港島實施分階段封路。
body: 警方周一公布，為配合10月1日國慶煙花匯演，當日下午起將在維多利亞港兩岸分階段實施道路封閉。煙花於晚上8時開始，歷時約23分鐘，預料吸引約26萬名觀眾。
九龍方面，首階段封路於下午5時在尖沙咀及尖東一帶實施，涉及廣東道、彌敦道、梳士巴利道等。其後於下午5時半、6時及7時45分分階段擴大至九龍公園徑、天星碼頭巴士總站、西九文化區及紅磡一帶。
港島方面，大部分封路於晚上6時半起在中區、灣仔及東區實施；金紫荊廣場則於下午4時封閉。中環灣仔繞道及東區走廊部分路段亦會受影響。
海事處將於晚上7時起在維港中部設立限制區。當日陸路口岸不會延長開放時間。西九龍站外將增設臨時過境巴士站，方便前往皇崗及深圳灣口岸的乘客。
